page_title: LEV 1-1 BAY | Bayer Leverkusen v Bayern Munich 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Christian Dingert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
90+10' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short.
90+9' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+8' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.

90+7' Sven Ulreich (Bayern Munich) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. Sven Ulreich (Bayern Munich) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

90+7' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Sven Ulreich leaps like a salmon to deny him.
90+6' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90+5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
90+5' The referee is firm and issues Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) a deserved yellow card. Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) will miss the next game.
90+5' Celebrations are cut short for Bayer Leverkusen as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+4' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Bayer Leverkusen players aren’t happy.
90+3' Goal! Exequiel Palacios plays it to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Sven Ulreich. 2:1.
90+2' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90+2' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.

90' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Sven Ulreich pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.
90' Corner kicks – 2:1. The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:12.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Michael Olise.
88' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Konrad Laimer is replaced by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).

87' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Ernest Poku.

86' What a wasted opportunity by Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Sven Ulreich makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
84' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) must have forgotten about the first yellow card that he received because he is shown a second one by the referee after his bad challenge!
84' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
80' The corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.

80' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
77' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
77' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to substitute Montrell Culbreath and he is replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Exequiel Palacios replaces him.
75' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
74' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
74' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
73' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
71' Great save! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Janis Blaswich.
71' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
70' Vincent Kompany is stunned as referee Christian Dingert shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

69' 1 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:1.
69' 9:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 3:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
67' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
67' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find Christian Kofane with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

66' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Christian Kofane. Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
64' Celebrations are cut short for Bayern Munich as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
63' Wait! Referee Christian Dingert has indicated he is going to review the Bayern Munich goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
61' Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:1.
61' The substitution is prepared. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aleksandar Pavlovic.
61' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Lennart Karl will be replaced by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich).
61' The game has come to an end for Patrik Schick. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).

59' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Sven Ulreich pulls off a brilliant save.
58' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
57' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
53' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
51' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.

49' Luis Diaz nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance. Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
48' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Maza is coming onto the pitch as Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
45+4' The corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared away by the defence.

45+4' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

45+2' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A pass into the box finds Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Sven Ulreich denies him.
42' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

42' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich), but referee Christian Dingert must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
41' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
39' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
39' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:4. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
32' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
31' Patrik Schick picks out Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen), who drives a shot just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
31' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
28' The goal by Bayern Munich is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
27' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Christian Dingert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

26' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) determinedly makes his way to the ball from the resulting set piece, but only manages to connect with his body. It's enough to beat the goalkeeper, however, and make it 1:1.
25' A clumsy foul by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) and Christian Dingert blows his whistle. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' CHANCE! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
24' The ball is cleared after Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

24' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Janis Blaswich pulls off an easy save.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
22' This shall not pass! Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
19' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
19' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) brought his opponent down. Bayern Munich will take a free kick near the side line.
18' A pass from Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Janis Blaswich and the move breaks down.
16' The ball possession is 31:69.
15' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
15' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Referee Christian Dingert sees the trip by Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
11' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Malik Tillman picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
9' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a terrific long ball forward to Patrik Schick, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
9' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) latches onto a short pass from Josip Stanisic inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
8' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Patrik Schick plays it to Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Sven Ulreich. 1:0.
4' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

2' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Patrik Schick, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Christian Dingert is the one to supervise the game today.
